author: kon333
body:
Hey, we have just had a large roster revamp and are starting to rebuild up with stronger and more experienced players. If you wish to join you just need to meet these requirements.


Have a mic / or be able to get one in a month of applying.

Have discord.

Be able to handle yourself in a 1v1 situation.

Be able to speak / listen well.

Although not really needed you do need to have a little experience in competitive.

Be active on discord and in game. (Very important)


Previous places in official / unofficial tournaments: 9th place T5, 3rd place The Wool, 7th place T6.


Current roster: https://avicus.net/teams/1348
